title: I Used to Be Afraid of the Dark

paragraphs.en: I used to be afraid of the dark. I couldn't sleep alone.
paragraphs.cn: 我过去害怕黑暗。我不能独自睡觉。

paragraphs.en: But now I am brave. I can sleep by myself in my own room.
paragraphs.cn: 但现在我很勇敢。我可以自己一个人在自己的房间里睡觉。

paragraphs.en: My sister used to be shy. She didn't like talking to strangers.
paragraphs.cn: 我妹妹过去很害羞。她不喜欢和陌生人说话。

paragraphs.en: Now she is outgoing and makes friends easily. She has changed a lot.
paragraphs.cn: 现在她很外向，很容易交到朋友。她改变了很多。

paragraphs.en: People change as they grow up. That is a natural part of life.
paragraphs.cn: 人们在成长过程中会改变。那是生命中很自然的一部分。

paragraphs.en: We should accept our changes and become better every day.
paragraphs.cn: 我们应该接受自己的变化，每天都变得更好。
